{{Short description|Swiss zoologist and naturalist (1833–1916)}}
{{For|the German mathematician|Karl Heinrich Gräffe}}
'''Eduard Heinrich Graeffe''' or '''Gräffe''' (27 December 1833, [[Zurich]] &ndash; 23 April 1916 [[Ljubljana]]) was a [[Swiss people|Swiss]] [[zoologist]] and [[naturalist]]. As an [[entomologist]], he specialised in [[Hymenoptera]], [[Diptera]] and [[Hemiptera]].

From around 1860, Graeffe was in the employ of [[Johann Cesar VI. Godeffroy]], a wealthy shipping magnate from [[Hamburg]]. Graeffe was hired in order to organize Godeffroy's natural history collection as a scientific museum, the "[[Museum Godeffroy]]".<ref>[https://books.google.com/books?id=2PodXOKpGp8C&dq=Graeffe+Godeffroy&pg=PA94 Discovery of Australia's Fishes] A History of Australian Ichthyology to 1930 by Brian Saunders</ref><ref name= LH>[http://www.sysbot.biologie.uni-muenchen.de/botsyst/ic/ic-lic-g.htm Collectors Index Herbarium] Lichen herbaria</ref><ref>Note: The museum contained insects from [[Australia]], [[Samoa]], [[Fiji]], [[Tonga]], the [[Phoenix Islands]] etc., and also functioned as a dealership in natural history material.</ref> From 1862 to 1873, he was based in [[Samoa]],<ref name=LH/> conducting scientific research and collecting specimens from throughout the South Pacific. Among his writings of the expedition was: ''Reisen im Innern dei Insel Viti Levu'' (in: Neujahrsblatt der Naturforschende Gesellschaft in Zürich auf das Jahr 1868, Nr. 70).<ref>[http://www.ngzh.ch/Neuj1868.html Reisen im Inneren der Insel Viti-Levu] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131020070350/http://www.ngzh.ch/Neuj1868.html |date=2013-10-20 }} Neujahrsblatt der Naturforschenden Gesellschaft in Zürich auf das Jahr 1868, Nr. 70.</ref>

From 1875 to 1898, he worked as an inspector at the Zoological Station in [[Trieste]].<ref>[https://books.google.com/books?id=jJQdAQAAIAAJ&dq=%22+Zoological+Station+in+Trieste%22&pg=PA250 Google Books] Collected Papers by Charles Atwood Kofoid</ref> The [[Fiji whistler]] (''Pachycephala graeffii'') is named in honor,<ref>[http://avibase.bsc-eoc.org/species.jsp?avibaseid=C5A3350D6A421212 Avibase] Fiji Whistler (Pachycephala graeffii)</ref><ref>[http://www.slideshare.net/mahmoudghonim/helm-dictionary-of-scientific-bird-names Helm dictionary of scientific bird names - SlideShare] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151119135008/http://www.slideshare.net/mahmoudghonim/helm-dictionary-of-scientific-bird-names |date=2015-11-19 }}</ref> as is ''Arthrocormus graeffii'', a [[botanical]] species described by German [[bryologist]] [[Karl Müller (bryologist)|Karl Müller]].<ref>[https://books.google.com/books?id=8VEUIH15wAYC&dq=graeffii+Graeffe&pg=PA148 Lexikon deutschsprachiger Bryologen. &#91;Hauptbd.&#93;, Volume 1] by JanPeter Frahm, Jens Eggers</ref>

== Selected works ==
* ''Beobachtungen über Radiaten und Würmer in Nizza'', 1858 - Observations of [[Radiata]] and worms in [[Nice]].
* ''Das Susswasser-Aquarium''. (1861) - The [[freshwater aquarium]].
* ''Reisen nach verschiedenen Inseln der Südsee'' 1867-68 - Journeys to different islands in the South Seas.
* ''Reise im Innern dei Insel Viti-Levu''. Neuejahrblatt der Naturforschende Gesellschaft in Zurich 70: 1-48. (1868) - Journey in the interior of [[Viti Levu]]. Translated into English by  Stefanie Vuikabe Waine and published as "Travels in the interior of Vitilevu" (1986). 
* ''Ueber eine Sendung Vögel aus Huahine'', 1873 - About an avian shipment from [[Huahine]].
* ''Topographie von Samoa'', 1873 - The topography of Samoa.
* ''Samoa oder die Schifferinseln''. 1873 - Samoa or the Schiffer Islands.
* ''Algen der Fidschi-, Tonga- und Samoa-Inseln, gesammelt von Eduard Graeffe'', 1874 (with [[Albert Grunow]]) - [[Algae]] from [[Fiji]], [[Tonga]] and Samoa.
* ''Coelenteraten'', 1882 - [[Coelenterata]].
* ''Ueber die Sprache, Sitten und Gebräuche der Samoaner'', 1888 - On the language, customs and other particulars of Samoans. 
* ''Contributo alla Fauna dei Ditteri dei dintorni di Trieste''. S.1-25. Trieste (1895), (with A. Funk).<ref>[http://www.google.com/search?tbo=p&tbm=bks&q=inauthor:%22Eduard+Graeffe%22 Google Books] Contributo alla Fauna dei Ditteri dei dintorni di Trieste</ref>
* ''Übersicht der Grabwespen (Fossores) des Küstenlandes'', (1912).<ref>[http://www.landesmuseum.at/pdf_frei_remote/ANNA_35_0036-0106.pdf] Beiträge zur Hymenopterenfauna Dalmatiens, Montenegros und Albaniens</ref>
* ''Die Carolineninsel Yap oder Guap nach den Mittheilungen von Alf. Tetens und Johann Kubary'', (Microform Reprint New Haven, Conn.) - The [[Caroline Islands|Carolines island]] of [[Yap Island|Yap]] or Guap according to the reports of [[Alfred Tetens]] and [[John Stanislaw Kubary|Johann Kubary]].<ref>[http://www.worldcat.org/search?q=au%3AGraeffe%2C+Eduard.&qt=hot_author WorldCat Search] (publications)</ref><ref>[http://www.google.com/search?tbo=p&tbm=bks&q=inauthor:%22Eduard+Graeffe%22 Google Books] (publications)</ref>

==Collections==
Initially Graeffe's insect collection was in Das [[Museum Godeffroy]] in Hamburg. This collection was sold and Graeffe's specimens (and the material he had worked on) were divided between [[Museo Civico di Storia Naturale di Trieste]] (Hymenoptera, Diptera, [[Orthoptera]] and Hemiptera) and the [[Naturhistorisches Museum]] (Hymenoptera, [[Orthoptera]] Diptera and Hemiptera). At least some material also ended up in the [[Museum für Naturkunde]] in [[Berlin]].
